description: This file implements functions for serializing and parsing HTTP stream priority values in the QUIC protocol, including handling structured headers and internal priority representations.

methods.name: SerializePriorityFieldValue
methods.description: Serializes an HttpStreamPriority object into a structured header string, including handling default values and validation.

methods.name: ParsePriorityFieldValue
methods.description: Parses a structured header string into an HttpStreamPriority object, extracting urgency and incremental flags with validation.
